data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Hachmin means 'God's treasure'. This name is associated with the biblical story of the three Hebrew boys, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who remained faithful to God in the fiery furnace and were saved by God. This name symbolizes courage, faith, and loyalty to one's beliefs. The name Hachmin carries the meaning “God's treasure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hachmin usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
